- [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) is back with another edition of South Bay Weeknight Brain Freeze! 
- This competition will be held **on a weeknight** without traditional events such as 3x3. 
- This competition will be occuring on the same night and in the same venue as the Mountain View location of [WCC FMC Leap Day 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCFMCLeapDay2024). This one will begin **after** WCC FMC Leap Day 2024 is finished.
